title: Diagnostic Report: Autodesk (autodesk.com)
summary: Autodesk.com scores 48/100 with critical mobile performance issues (LCP 25.7s, 13MB page weight, Performance score 26/100), missing structured data on product pages, and aggressive Akamai bot detection blocking sitemap/robots.txt access. Strong content engine with 297+ editorial pages across 4 blog verticals. Site receives ~36.1M monthly visits with 44.7% from search.
